name: housekeeping-worktree-held-default-branch
title: Housekeeping is not worktree-aware, so a default branch held elsewhere yields two opaque anomalies and skipped cleanup
description: git switch fails with "fatal: 'main' is already used by worktree at <path>" when another worktree holds the default branch. That stderr reaches the terminal but never the structured result: the anomaly records only default_branch_switch_failed, which then cascades into a free-standing branch_switch_incomplete and skipped branch deletion. Neither anomaly names a worktree, nothing links them, and housekeeping never calls git worktree list. Observed across a 14-PR merge session on 2026-08-08 (#358-#379), with PR #358 and #364 captured verbatim: every merge action succeeded and the verdict was still blocked. Reporting and verdict fix only — the refusal to switch is correct.
